Container.Name: claude-sandbox
Container.Overview: Sandboxed Claude Code for unattended agentic development. The container firewalls itself against your LAN (internet only, plus explicit exceptions) and then drops the capability to change those rules. For more than one sandbox, give each its own Name, the same --hostname in Extra Parameters (also its Remote Control name) and its own folders.

Config.Name: Home
Config.Description: Claude Code install, login and settings

Config.Name: Backup
Config.Description: Daily archives of Claude's memory, transcripts and settings (no secrets), last 7 kept. Back this up instead of Home.

Config.Name: LAN exceptions
Config.Description: Space-separated host:port (TCP) the sandbox may reach in your LAN, e.g. a Git server: 192.168.1.10:3000

Config.Name: Continue conversation
Config.Description: yes: after a restart (container restart, image update, reboot) Claude continues the last conversation. no: it starts a new one each time. Switching host access always continues.

Config.Name: Extra blocked ranges
Config.Description: Additional IPv4 CIDRs to block (private ranges are always blocked)
